correctness.rationale: All 8192 and 131072 labelled configurations were deterministically enumerated by two independent-from-scratch graph/update/traversal implementations. Python uses quadratic-residue adjacency plus indegree peeling and reverse traversal; C++ uses Euler-criterion adjacency plus successor-path tracking. Their complete count, full depth histogram, and basin-size multiplicity agree and satisfy exact mass conservation. The finite algorithm completeness follows from standard functional-graph decomposition. The nonempty entry-depth-six strata prove F^8=F^6 and F^7≠F^5 sharply. Reproducible scripts, results and exact domain supplied; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Paley-13 and Paley-17 are canonical prime-order self-complementary quadratic-residue graphs; Paley-17 is the classical Ramsey extremizer. The exact basin-size spectra and contrast of zero versus 1530 oscillatory attractors are natural deterministic finite-system invariants, not arbitrary subsets or reformulated textbook deductions. The shared sharp six-update cutoff and high yet nonuniversal consensus probabilities provide a meaningful benchmark for graph-sensitive voting dynamics. The claim makes no assertion of a universal prime-order phase transition.
